title: New Repository to Production
description: A recommended workflow for taking a new or unmaintained project to a production-ready state using the Jules Prompts library.

steps.title: Repair the Environment Setup Script
steps.description: Make the repository reliably usable by an agent: dependencies install, tests run, nothing blocks.

steps.title: Audit the Repository
steps.description: Conduct a comprehensive, evidence-based audit to understand the project's current state.

steps.title: Harden the Repository
steps.description: Set up CI/CD pipeline, testing infrastructure, and development best practices.

steps.title: Fix and Refine
steps.description: Address bugs, technical debt, and architectural issues discovered during the audit.

steps.title: Ongoing Maintenance
steps.description: Continuously improve with better tests, coverage, and small feature enhancements.
